test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 7 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Out of the following five figures, four are alike in some manner and one differs from these in that manner. Select the odd figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21f6272d9f53ad2e547317efe0eb1123a6a504a5985bde83b0009f2171e61561.png]
solution:
**Logic : In each figure there are atleast two same figures.**

So,

 
• Option - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/beae20a3580866e51356f8a44216ab84b2e085f0be01a7625ec195493a3726bf.png] ⇒ There are two squares and one circle.

 
• Option - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dec71d0483ac2a4eaeed4cdea9f1c35b399389904efad7c43d3ebb89d36c7b04.png] ⇒ There are two triangles and one circle.

 
• Option - (3) : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/119ffd4cb33b30843fafe376283f45e7b4daf9344cfb867858beffa0cddf1145.png] **⇒ **All the figures are different i.e one triangle, one circle and one square.

 
• Option - (4) :
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8616e166d8a44737cd152613ad615fd8fb48b285f27e529517a193dc5be5517d.png] ⇒ There are two circles and one sqaure.

**Here, Figure - (3) is the odd one out.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f668d99ae24080e602d64d78260b602cbad0c104b604af3e428fcdf17c1751b.png] 

Hence, **"Option - (3)"** is the correct answer.
